description: First end-to-end reasoner system test: a mixed relational question set scored through the real Router (compiler -> executor -> verbalizer). Exercises entity<->entity (directional) and entity<->surface (proximity, contact, support) facts plus honest deferrals. NOT comparable to the v1 benchmark; a separate reasoner-native eval track (Phase 5 D5).

score_categories.true_answer: expected answer; system answered; cited entities cover expected_must_contain and include none of expected_must_not_contain
score_categories.false_answer: system answered when expected was defer/empty (fabricated fact), OR answered including a must_not_contain entity
score_categories.miss: expected answer; system answered but missed an expected_must_contain entity (or returned empty/unknown)
score_categories.correct_defer: expected defer; system deferred (out_of_schema -> abstain with a deferred: note)
score_categories.unexpected: outcome did not match the expected category; carries the actual outcome for attribution

grounding_note: All expected_must_contain entities were verified by measurement against the live enriched-v2 bundle before freezing (lamp/wall contact at 0.02/0.02; stool on floor; stool left of blanket; cabinet near a wall). expected_must_not_contain pins the no-false-attachment guard.

questions.question: what is on the floor?
questions.notes: Existing Phase 4 floor-support path must still work. obj_39 (stool) is a known floor rest.

questions.question: what is against the wall?
questions.notes: New wall-contact path. obj_6 (lamp) is the only real wall contact under the frozen 0.02/0.02 band. The picture (obj_63), pillar (obj_84), and window (obj_17) MUST NOT appear -- their inclusion would be a false_answer (no false attachment / no structural contamination).

questions.question: what is on the table?
questions.notes: Table support needs EntitySurface/tabletop geometry not present in Replica room_0. Must defer (out_of_schema, deferred:), not answer and not empty.

questions.question: what is left of the blanket?
questions.notes: Existing entity<->entity directional path. obj_86 (blanket) has exactly one LEFT_OF source: obj_39 (stool).

questions.question: what is near the wall?
questions.notes: SurfaceRef-anchored NEAR_SURFACE -- the generic stored-edge helper (P5.03) must resolve a surface anchor. 40 entities are near a wall; obj_2 (cabinet) is one. Distinct from Q2: 'near' is proximity, 'against' is contact.

questions.question: what is attached to the wall?
questions.notes: Attachment is deferred in P5 (D2: 'against' != 'attached'). Asking for attachment must defer, NOT fabricate an attachment from wall contact. This is the no-false-attachment probe: a system that answered this with the lamp (or anything) would be claiming attachment it did not earn.
